description: Embedding permutation test: randomly permutes rows of the embedding matrix E and measures the bridge loss under three conditions — baseline (normal E), permuted (E_perm as source only), and inverse-permuted (E_perm as both source and target). If the bridge breaks under permutation, it confirms that semantic alignment of embeddings matters (the bridge is not just a geometric trick). Tests layers 0, 12, 23 of Qwen3.5-0.8B.
